errors.description: thermal_code_q is a multi-bit value produced in thermal_clk and sampled directly in pmu_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
overtemp_pulse_q is a one-cycle thermal_clk pulse consumed directly in pmu_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
overtemp_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample pmu_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in pmu_event_o.
trip_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector trip_mode_q before decoding in pmu_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
thermal_rst_n is used as data inside pmu_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
aon_snapshot_q combines thermal_clk payload state with pmu_clk status state in aon_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
